sections.title: Components annotate, themes style
body: Every element a component renders carries semantic attributes such as data-list-item and data-selected. Those attributes are the styling contract, and they read like documentation.

sections.title: Style, skin and mode
body: A style sets shape and spacing (rokkit, minimal, material, frosted, zen-sumi and more). A skin sets the colour values. A mode flips light and dark. They change independently.

sections.title: Paper, ink, primary
body: Instead of shade numbers, themes use a named vocabulary: paper, paper-soft, ink, ink-mute, primary, success and so on. Written once, a theme works in both modes.

sections.title: Consistency by construction
body: When an assistant writes UI with named tokens, it cannot invent a new grey. The design system stays a system.
